title: Tanker report - Week 21
summary:
Clean
LR2
The TC1 75kt MEG/Japan index softened a little this week, dropping 16 points to WS530. A voyage west also saw the TC20 90kt MEG/UK-Continent index dip by $346,000 to $10.38 million. The TC15 80kt Mediterranean/East index came down a further $770,000 this week to $7.53 million with the corresponding TCE dropping to $58,000/day on Baltic description round trip.

children.title: VLCC
children.summary: The continuing uncertainty due to the ongoing Middle East crisis remains difficult for parties involved in oil shipping. The Baltic panellists assess the rate for the TD3C route (270,000mt Middle East Gulf to China) 45 points lower than last Friday at WS402.5, which corresponds to a daily round-trip TCE of $397,753 for the standard Baltic VLCC.

children.title: Suezmax
children.summary: In the Suezmax sector, the rate for the 130,000mt Nigeria/UK Continent voyage (TD20) trip dipped again, losing 7 points to the WS187 level which translates into a daily round-trip TCE of about $76,400. The TD27 route (Guyana to UK Continent basis 130,000mt) lost about 9 points to the WS185 level, giving a daily round trip TCE of about $76,800.

children.title: Aframax
children.summary: In the North Sea, the rate for 80,000mt Cross-UK Continent route (TD7) is again lower, losing 7.5 points this week to WS174.58, giving a daily round-trip TCE of about $65,150 basis Hound Point to Wilhelmshaven. In the Mediterranean, the rate for 80,000mt Cross-Mediterranean (TD19) fell slightly this week, losing 2.5 points to WS173.61 (basis Ceyhan to Lavera, this shows a daily round trip TCE of just over $32,250).
